text:
You end up in a creepy old
mansion. There is a 1 in 6 chance
of an encounter with a creature
from the Possessed table. If this
does not happen, there is a 3 in 6
chance of an encounter from the
Ghosts Table. In any case, you have
found a hell gate and the name of
the demon FLAUROS written on a
wall. If you have the Gate Arcane
Skill, you may perform a L6 Magic
roll to close it. If you close it, you
may ignore the next 3 encounters
that happen to you, and you
recover 2 Sanity. If you fail to close
it, you are cursed and your chance
of meeting wandering monsters
increases by 1 (so 2 in 6 every time
you visit an already visited box)
until you find another hell gate and
manage to close it, or find a magic
item or ritual that dispels the curse.
You may just ignore the hell gate if
you prefer.

zh-CN.title: 1 - 阴森的古宅
text: 你来到一座令人毛骨悚然的古宅。遭遇一只附身生物的概率为1/6；若没有遭遇，则有3/6的概率遭遇一只幽灵。无论如何，你都发现了一道地狱之门，墙上写着恶魔弗劳罗斯（FLAUROS）的名字。若你拥有“门”奥术技能，可以进行一次L6魔法检定来关闭它。若成功关闭，你可以忽略接下来发生的3次遭遇，并恢复2点理智。若未能关闭，你便会受到诅咒：在找到并成功关闭另一道地狱之门，或找到能解除诅咒的魔法物品或仪式之前，每次进入已探索过的区域时，遭遇游荡怪物的概率都会提高1（变为2/6）。如果愿意，你也可以不理会这道地狱之门。
